# Crownwood Chemicals - Product and Service Reference

## Company

Crownwood Chemicals supplies road and soil products and provides construction services for commercial and municipal projects in Texas. Crownwood is based in San Antonio.

This reference intentionally distinguishes manufacturer-published facts from project-specific information that must be confirmed before purchase or field use.

## PCT Fastphalt Road Products

### Dust Defeater (formerly Dust-X)

- Use: dust control on gravel roads, dirt roads, and farms
- Published features: no heat required; all-season cold pour; dilute with up to 3 parts water; apply with a water or distributor truck
- Manufacturer sheet states organic certification from OMRI; confirm current certification
- Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/dust-defeater

### PHPM-50 (now marketed by PCT as FP PrimePatch)

- Use: tack membrane for pothole patching and asphalt overlays
- Published features: no heat required; compatible with all patch mixes; liquid stable; freeze protection required during storage
- PCT states patch life may increase by up to 5 times and that the product seals against water infiltration
- Manufacturer sheet states NSF/ANSI 61 certification; confirm current certification
- Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/phpm-50

### Banana Slide

- Use: asphalt release treatment applied before use to tools, truck beds, belts, hoppers, and augers
- Published features: diesel replacement; pump-sprayer application; high flash point; low viscosity; 8-year stated shelf life
- Storage: keep out of direct sunlight and protect from freezing
- Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/banana-slide

### FP Blacktrac

- Use: sprayable friction-course membrane sealer for low-volume hot-mix roads
- Published features: no heat required; fast dry; liquid stable; easy to spray
- PCT states a 2-3 year treatment life and up to 5 years of added road life; project results vary
- Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/fp-blacktrac

### Rumbleguard

- Use: preventive preservation of milled rumble strips and surrounding pavement
- Published goals: slow wear and UV deterioration, seal small cracks, reduce water infiltration, delay rehabilitation, and preserve strip function
- Contact Crownwood to confirm the application rate, equipment, cure time, packaging, and compatibility for the project
- Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/rumbleguard

### Eco Black (COS-50)

- Use: no-heat sealing and appearance renewal for low-speed asphalt and chip-seal surfaces
- Published applications: residential streets and parking lots
- Published goal: limit water entry into the pavement base
- Manufacturer sheet states NSF/ANSI 61 certification; confirm current certification
- Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/eco-black

### BAM (Bonding Adhesive Material)

- Use: spray-injection pothole patching, rural shoulder repair, stockpile mix with rock, and throw-and-roll repair
- Published features: ready to use; no heat; non-clogging; non-settling; immediate traffic
- PCT states applications may last up to 10 times longer than conventional pothole repairs; project results vary
- PCT states the hydrocarbon resins meet ANSI/NSF 61 standards; confirm current documentation
- Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/bam

### Monkey Business

- Use: cleaning grease, tar, and asphalt buildup
- Published features: D-limonene solution; dilute with up to 5 parts water; described by PCT as all-natural and environmentally friendly
- Current SDS, surface compatibility, dwell, rinse, and PPE instructions should be confirmed
- Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/monkey-business

## Crownwood Product Pages

### Permabase

Permabase is presented as a concentrated bio-enzyme soil-treatment option for suitable cohesive soil. Project selection should consider soil classification, plasticity, gradation, moisture, treatment depth, density target, loading, drainage, and testing. Request current technical and safety documentation.

Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/permabase

### Permabase Black

Permabase Black is presented as a tinted Permabase soil treatment for selected low-speed roads, yards, access routes, and working surfaces. It is not described as hot-mix asphalt. Confirm soil response, traffic, drainage, finish, rates, and maintenance with a demonstration section where appropriate.

Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/permabase-black

### MeltDown MR-1

MeltDown MR-1 is presented as a soy-based asphalt remover and release treatment for compatible paving equipment and tools. Current technical data and SDS should govern surface compatibility, dwell, residue management, PPE, storage, and use.

Page: https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/meltdown

## Construction Services

Crownwood provides asphalt paving, commercial concrete, sealcoating, parking-lot striping, land clearing and site preparation, and hydroseeding and erosion-control services in San Antonio and surrounding areas.

Service pages describe typical scope, project information needed for pricing, a four-step planning process, and limitations. They do not guarantee code approval, inspection outcomes, universal service life, or permanent performance.
